notes: This document is Amendment Number Four to Contract #20-001 for Voter Registration System License and Support Services (term extended through December 31, 2026, contract sum $5,153,898). The amendment addresses term extension, definitions, pricing schedule, hiring initiatives, public records, and campaign contribution prohibitions only. No insurance provisions are contained in this amendment. The original contract's insurance requirements (from the base contract executed January 1, 2021) are not included in this excerpt and must be reviewed separately for a complete picture of LA County's insurance obligations.
